# Corruption minigame (generated by tools/romania_focus_gen/corruption.py).
# ROM_corruption is 0-100. Change it only through ROM_corruption_apply (set the temp
# variable rom_corr_delta first) or through ROM_corruption_update after a direct change.

ROM_corruption_init = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = ROM_corruption } }
		set_variable = { ROM_corruption = 38 }
		set_variable = { ROM_corr_week = 0 }
		ROM_corruption_update = yes
	}
}

# Reforms change how hard corruption is to raise and to cut:
#  - binding audits and a professional civil service make new graft 25% / 20% smaller;
#  - above 60, entrenched networks blunt every clean-up by 30%, unless whistleblowers are protected;
#  - open e-procurement makes every clean-up 20% more effective.
ROM_corruption_apply = {
	ROM_corruption_init = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { rom_corr_delta > 0 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = ROM_corr_audit } multiply_temp_variable = { rom_corr_delta = 0.75 } }
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = ROM_corr_civil_service } multiply_temp_variable = { rom_corr_delta = 0.8 } }
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { ROM_corruption > 59 }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = ROM_corr_whistle }
			}
			multiply_temp_variable = { rom_corr_delta = 0.7 }
		}
		if = { limit = { has_country_flag = ROM_corr_eproc } multiply_temp_variable = { rom_corr_delta = 1.2 } }
	}
	add_to_variable = { ROM_corruption = rom_corr_delta }
	ROM_corruption_update = yes
}

ROM_corruption_clear_tiers = {
	if = { limit = { has_idea = ROM_corruption_1 } remove_ideas = ROM_corruption_1 }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = ROM_corruption_2 } remove_ideas = ROM_corruption_2 }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = ROM_corruption_3 } remove_ideas = ROM_corruption_3 }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = ROM_corruption_4 } remove_ideas = ROM_corruption_4 }
	if = { limit = { has_idea = ROM_corruption_5 } remove_ideas = ROM_corruption_5 }
}

# Bounds the value and keeps exactly one tier spirit. Safe to call any number of times.
ROM_corruption_update = {
	clamp_variable = { var = ROM_corruption min = 0 max = 100 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { ROM_corruption < 20 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = ROM_corruption_1 } } ROM_corruption_clear_tiers = yes add_ideas = ROM_corruption_1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { ROM_corruption < 40 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = ROM_corruption_2 } } ROM_corruption_clear_tiers = yes add_ideas = ROM_corruption_2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { ROM_corruption < 60 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = ROM_corruption_3 } } ROM_corruption_clear_tiers = yes add_ideas = ROM_corruption_3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { ROM_corruption < 80 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = ROM_corruption_4 } } ROM_corruption_clear_tiers = yes add_ideas = ROM_corruption_4 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = ROM_corr_warned_severe } }
			set_country_flag = ROM_corr_warned_severe
			country_event = { id = ROM_corrupt.30}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = ROM_corruption_5 } } ROM_corruption_clear_tiers = yes add_ideas = ROM_corruption_5 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = ROM_corr_warned_systemic } }
			set_country_flag = ROM_corr_warned_systemic
			country_event = { id = ROM_corrupt.31}
		}
	}
}

ROM_corruption_weekly = {
	ROM_corruption_init = yes
	add_to_variable = { ROM_corr_week = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { ROM_corr_week > 3 } }
		set_variable = { ROM_corr_week = 0 }
		ROM_corruption_monthly = yes
	}
}

# Monthly drift: patronage creeps upward on its own unless institutions push back.
ROM_corruption_monthly = {
	set_temp_variable = { rom_corr_drift = 0.5 }
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { ROM_corruption > 59 } } add_to_temp_variable = { rom_corr_drift = 0.5 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = ROM_corr_patronage_system } add_to_temp_variable = { rom_corr_drift = 0.5 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = ROM_corr_civil_service } add_to_temp_variable = { rom_corr_drift = -0.5 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = ROM_corr_agency } add_to_temp_variable = { rom_corr_drift = -0.75 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = ROM_corr_state_control } add_to_temp_variable = { rom_corr_drift = -0.5 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = ROM_corr_church_ethics } add_to_temp_variable = { rom_corr_drift = -0.5 } }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = ROM_corr_blood_oath } add_to_temp_variable = { rom_corr_drift = -0.5 } }
	add_to_variable = { ROM_corruption = rom_corr_drift }
	ROM_corruption_update = yes
	ROM_paths_monthly = yes

	# A hidden fund cannot survive binding audits.
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ROM_corr_hidden_fund > 0 }
			has_country_flag = ROM_corr_audit
			NOT = { has_country_flag = ROM_corr_fund_exposed }
		}
		set_country_flag = ROM_corr_fund_exposed
		country_event = { id = ROM_corrupt.8}
	}

	# Scandal risk rises with every band above 40 and with every buried investigation.
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ROM_corruption > 39 }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = ROM_corr_scandal_cooldown }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ROM_corruption < 60 } }
			random = { chance = 8 ROM_corruption_scandal = yes }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { ROM_corruption < 80 } }
			random = { chance = 16 ROM_corruption_scandal = yes }
		}
		else = {
			random = { chance = 28 ROM_corruption_scandal = yes }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { ROM_corr_buried > 0 }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = ROM_corr_scandal_cooldown }
		}
		random = { chance = 5 ROM_corruption_scandal = yes }
	}

	# Three months in the systemic band brings the government itself into question.
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { ROM_corruption > 79 } }
		add_to_variable = { ROM_corr_systemic_months = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { ROM_corr_systemic_months > 2 }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = ROM_corr_systemic_crisis_cooldown }
			}
			set_country_flag = { flag = ROM_corr_systemic_crisis_cooldown days = 365 value = 1 }
			set_variable = { ROM_corr_systemic_months = 0 }
			country_event = { id = ROM_corrupt.14}
		}
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { ROM_corr_systemic_months = 0 }
	}
}

ROM_corruption_scandal = {
	set_country_flag = { flag = ROM_corr_scandal_cooldown days = 75 value = 1 }
	random_list = {
		20 = {
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = ROM_corr_s1_recent }
			modifier = { factor = 0.5 has_country_flag = ROM_corr_eproc }
			country_event = { id = ROM_corrupt.1}
		}
		15 = {
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = ROM_corr_s2_recent }
			country_event = { id = ROM_corrupt.2}
		}
		15 = {
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = ROM_corr_s3_recent }
			modifier = { factor = 0.5 has_country_flag = ROM_corr_eproc }
			country_event = { id = ROM_corrupt.3}
		}
		10 = {
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = ROM_corr_s4_recent }
			modifier = { factor = 2.5 has_country_flag = ROM_corr_whistle }
			country_event = { id = ROM_corrupt.4}
		}
		15 = {
			modifier = { factor = 0 check_variable = { ROM_corruption < 60 } }
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = ROM_corr_s6_recent }
			modifier = { factor = 0 NOT = { NOT = { 	has_country_flag = ROM_military_path 	has_country_flag = ROM_dracula_path } } }
			country_event = { id = ROM_corrupt.6}
		}
		25 = {
			modifier = { factor = 0 NOT = { has_country_flag = ROM_Crin_Antonescu_wins } }
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = ROM_corr_s9_recent }
			modifier = { factor = 2 check_variable = { ROM_corr_offsets > 0 } }
			country_event = { id = ROM_corrupt.9}
		}
		25 = {
			modifier = { factor = 0 NOT = { OR = { has_country_flag = ROM_George_Simion_wins has_country_flag = ROM_Gheorghe_Simion_wins } } }
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = ROM_corr_s10_recent }
			country_event = { id = ROM_corrupt.10}
		}
		25 = {
			modifier = { factor = 0 NOT = { has_country_flag = ROM_military_path } }
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = ROM_corr_s11_recent }
			country_event = { id = ROM_corrupt.11}
		}
		25 = {
			modifier = { factor = 0 NOT = { has_country_flag = ROM_orthodox_path } }
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = ROM_corr_s12_recent }
			country_event = { id = ROM_corrupt.12}
		}
		25 = {
			modifier = { factor = 0 NOT = { has_country_flag = ROM_monarchy_path } }
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = ROM_corr_s13_recent }
			country_event = { id = ROM_corrupt.13}
		}
		25 = {
			modifier = { factor = 0 NOT = { has_country_flag = ROM_dracula_path } }
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_country_flag = ROM_corr_s15_recent }
			country_event = { id = ROM_corrupt.15}
		}
	}
}

# Political fallout of a scandal, adapted to whichever path mechanic is active.
ROM_scandal_fallout_small = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = ROM_majority }
		add_to_variable = { ROM_majority = -3 }
		ROM_update_majority = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = ROM_legitimacy }
		add_to_variable = { ROM_legitimacy = -3 }
		ROM_update_legitimacy = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = ROM_consent }
		add_to_variable = { ROM_consent = -3 }
		ROM_update_consent = yes
	}
}

ROM_scandal_fallout_large = {
	ROM_scandal_fallout_small = yes
	ROM_scandal_fallout_small = yes
	add_stability = -0.03
}
